description: Asking for file metadata should select stat, not file/ls.
prompt: When was /etc/hosts last modified, and what are its permissions?

description: Cross-domain selection: a Dock preference request should reach the preferences tool's write_setting, not the filesystem tool. Single turn only (no confirmation sent), so no real change is ever applied by this case.

There is no discovery tool any more (Pattern A was replaced by domain tools whose descriptions embed the full menu) -- the model should be able to answer 'what can you do' from the tool descriptions it already has, without calling anything.
prompt: Without doing anything yet, what kinds of things can you help me with on this Mac?

description: Asking which windows are open on screen should select application/list_windows (the window inspector), not list_running_applications (which only names running apps, without windows/positions).
prompt: What windows do I have open on screen right now, and where are they positioned?

description: Asking what browser tabs are open should select application-safari/list_tabs, not the application-window inspector (list_windows) or the running-apps list. Selection-only: executing it reads the machine's live open tab URLs, so real-content assertions live in the manual smoke list; in CI (no personal browsing) routing is all that is checked.
prompt: What tabs do I have open in Safari right now?

description: Asking what page the user is currently looking at should select application-safari/current_tab (the front window's active tab), not list_tabs (the whole set). Selection-only for the same privacy reason as list_tabs_routing.
prompt: What web page am I currently looking at in Safari?

description: Asking for a person's FULL contact details (address, email, birthday — not just a number) should select application-contacts/get_contact, not application-phone/find_contact (numbers only). Selection-only: executing it reads the machine's real Contacts, so content assertions live in the manual smoke list; in CI routing is all that is checked. The name is a fake placeholder.
prompt: Show me Jane Doe's full contact card — her email and address, not just her phone.

description: Adding a new person to Contacts should stage application-contacts/create_contact and NOT commit (forbid_tools execute), so this is CI-safe: staging never touches the real Contacts database, it only builds the plan + confirmation token. Fake placeholder identity only — no real PII.
prompt: Create a new contact for Jane Doe at Example Corp, email jane@example.com.

description: Asking what song is playing should select application-music/now_playing, not the running-apps list or a window inspector. Selection-only: executing it reads live playback (what the user is listening to), so real-content assertions live in the manual smoke list; in CI routing is all that is checked. The play/pause/skip CONTROLS are auto-commit side effects, so they are deliberately kept out of this selection suite and only exercised manually.
prompt: What song is playing right now?

description: Asking whether an app is on the Mac App Store (and its price) should select application/search_app_store, not search_applications (that only checks what is ALREADY installed locally) or open_website. Selection-only: the operation makes a live outbound request to Apple's search API, so real result assertions live in the manual smoke list; in CI only the selection is checked (it holds even offline, since the expectation asserts tool+operation, not success).
prompt: Is Slack on the Mac App Store, and what does it cost?
